name: Biomedical Sciences PhD
institution: University of Tennessee Health Science Center
detailsNote: Official information available; dates are annual unless explicitly dated. Admission route not assigned where unconfirmed.

applicationFee.note: College states no application fee; foreign evaluation agencies charge separately.

english.note: College non-native-English policy also allows evidence of English proficiency; exemption terms and new TOEFL scale not specified. Confirm program-specific rules.

documents: Foreign transcript course-by-course evaluation when applicable
requirements.note: Bachelor degree, GPA 3, previous research, personal statement and three letters. Select up to three tracks, first preferred. Foreign records require course-by-course NACES evaluation without exception; send all records to CAS, not program staff. Track-determined minimum rotations during first year; six 6-week periods offered, not six required rotations.

funding.note: Current published stipend$30,900 plus health-insurance premium; future-year amount and tuition coverage not stated on Future Students page.
